title: Autoscroll devices when drag and dropping a stream
line: In the Audio Volume popup, dragging an application's stream near the top or bottom of the device list now scrolls the list, so every device can be reached.
explanation: Dragging a stream switches the popup to the Devices tab, but the device list is a scroll view that never scrolled during a drag, and the mouse wheel does nothing while dragging. With more devices than fit, the lower ones could not be reached as drop targets. The change tracks the drag position from the device rows (and from a drop area behind the list, for the current device and headers) and scrolls the list with a timer while the drag hovers within two grid units of its top or bottom edge.

commits.message:
applet: scroll the device list while dragging a stream near its edges

With many devices, the ones below the visible part of the list could not
be reached when dragging a stream onto them, as the list never scrolled
during the drag. Now it scrolls when the stream hovers near its edges.

BUG: 413672

patches.diff:
From 0089463acb692e8fa411970622dff981d8f09000 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 04:04:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: scroll the device list while dragging a stream near
 its edges

With many devices, the ones below the visible part of the list could not
be reached when dragging a stream onto them, as the list never scrolled
during the drag. Now it scrolls when the stream hovers near its edges.

BUG: 413672
---
 applet/ListItemBase.qml |  3 +++
 applet/main.qml         | 38 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 41 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applet/ListItemBase.qml b/applet/ListItemBase.qml
index 83fab21f..d6617e68 100644
--- a/applet/ListItemBase.qml
+++ b/applet/ListItemBase.qml
@@ -386,6 +386,9 @@ PC3.ItemDelegate {
         parent: item
         anchors.fill: parent
         enabled: main.draggedStream && main.draggedStream.deviceIndex !== item.model.Index
+        onEntered: drag => fullRep.updateDragScroll(dropArea, drag.y)
+        onPositionChanged: drag => fullRep.updateDragScroll(dropArea, drag.y)
+        onExited: fullRep.dragScrollDirection = 0
         onDropped: drop => {
             main.draggedStream.deviceIndex = item.model.Index;
         }
diff --git a/applet/main.qml b/applet/main.qml
index 1e44cded..47fe93d3 100644
--- a/applet/main.qml
+++ b/applet/main.qml
@@ -298,9 +298,36 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         function endMoveStream() {
             hiddenTypes = []
+            dragScrollDirection = 0
             tabBar.setCurrentIndex(streamsTab.PC3.TabBar.index)
         }
 
+        property int dragScrollDirection: 0
+
+        function updateDragScroll(item: Item, y: real) : void {
+            const view = contentView.currentItem
+            const viewY = item.mapToItem(view, 0, y).y
+            const margin = Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2
+            if (viewY < margin) {
+                dragScrollDirection = -1
+            } else if (viewY > view.height - margin) {
+                dragScrollDirection = 1
+            } else {
+                dragScrollDirection = 0
+            }
+        }
+
+        Timer {
+            interval: 16
+            repeat: true
+            running: fullRep.dragScrollDirection !== 0 && main.draggedStream !== null
+            onTriggered: {
+                const flickable = contentView.currentItem.contentItem
+                const contentY = flickable.contentY + fullRep.dragScrollDirection * Kirigami.Units.gridUnit / 2
+                flickable.contentY = Math.max(0, Math.min(contentY, flickable.contentHeight - flickable.height))
+            }
+        }
+
         Connections {
             target: main
             function onExpandedChanged() : void {
@@ -563,6 +590,17 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 lowerSection.currentIndex = -1
             }
 
+            DropArea {
+                id: dragScrollArea
+                parent: scrollView
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                z: -1
+                enabled: main.draggedStream !== null
+                onEntered: drag => fullRep.updateDragScroll(dragScrollArea, drag.y)
+                onPositionChanged: drag => fullRep.updateDragScroll(dragScrollArea, drag.y)
+                onExited: fullRep.dragScrollDirection = 0
+            }
+
             Loader {
                 parent: scrollView
                 anchors.centerIn: parent
--

media.caption: Master: the stream is dragged to the bottom of the device list and held there; the list doesn't move, and it can only be dropped on NullSink4
Fixed: holding the stream at the bottom edge scrolls the list down to NullSink14, and the stream is dropped there
Master, after holding at the bottom edge for several seconds: still NullSink1–5
Fixed, same moment: the list has scrolled to the last device, NullSink14

review.text: Adds edge auto-scroll during a stream drag in the device list, with a timer driven by the drag position from the row DropAreas plus a background DropArea, and resets it on exit and drop. It's a QML-only, contained change following the usual drag-autoscroll pattern; the video shows it reaching the last device and pactl confirms the drop target.
